document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Someone (something!) runs south, turns a corner, and disappears. 
He seems to have been intending to go to the northeast.
Do you follow? As you decide, you notice an enormous frieze 
depicting a war between two kinds of beings, beings never before 
seen by man, and waging wars of incredible cruelty and horror. 
Do you follow the man? If so, go to 570. If you do not follow, 
you find walls bar your way, return to 552.
(547, 552, 561, 570)
